notes: tool create:cardboard_sword (sword, CardboardSwordItem extends SwordItem, tier CARDBOARD (uses 0)): breaks minecraft:short_grass. Inventory is observed before and after the break, so the durability delta (per stack damage / max_damage in the record's durability field) is the tool's wear. Expected from vanilla rules, not verified: a sword does 2 damage only on blocks with destroy speed > 0, and short grass has destroy speed 0, so no wear is expected. The census tool flag is no. If the tool is not damageable (CARDBOARD uses 0), no damage field is expected at all.
